title: C++: Mini Testing Framework
description: Build a simple testing framework with ASSERT macros and a test runner.

steps.title: Testing Framework
steps.description: Define macros ASSERT_EQ(a,b) and ASSERT_TRUE(c) that print PASS/FAIL with location info. Track global pass/fail counts. Create 3 tests: test_add, test_sub, test_false.
hints: #define ASSERT_EQ(a,b) do { if ((a)!=(b)) { cout << "FAIL\n"; fails++; } else { cout << "PASS\n"; passes++; } } while(0)

verification.failureMessage: Run tests and print pass/fail counts
